== Lead photograph (30 Oct 2026) ==
The lead is a crop of a Facebook photograph posted 5 September 2024. The Facebook photo viewer names Cat Ceder. Identification: distinctive name plus Rogue 14 on the Decipher Squadron roster (Santa Barbara, Ca). The Facebook profile is facebook.com/StaticCat and lists Santa Barbara Senior High and Santa Barbara City College, with a later home in Peoria, Arizona. The uncropped original also shows two unlabeled people at the table; the lead crop is Ceder alone. Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot. Identification stays on Talk. See [[:File:Cat Ceder portrait.jpg]] and [[:File:Cat Ceder Facebook portrait.jpg]].
